name: Airsoft FE
desc:
Airsoft FE is a fast-paced realistic airsoft shooter! Unlock a variety of unique airsoft weapons that enhance your ability to dominate the chaotic airsoft battlegrounds!

🌟 LATEST UPDATE - 5 New Weapons, New Map, Festive Events, and much more additions/changes! Check out the patch notes in-game to see all of the details!

🎮 Available on Desktop, Phones, Tablets, XBOX, and PlayStation!
⚠️ Any form of exploitation will not be tolerated and will result in a permanent ban.
👍 We appreciate the support from everyone! Thanks for playing!

Relevant Keywords - Airsoft, FE, 1v1, fps, shooter, realistic
